collection.description: A villager feels a sneeze coming at exactly the wrong moment.

intro.name: The sneeze
intro.text: (Sneezer) develops an irresistible tickle in (sneezer.his/her) nose at precisely the wrong moment.

s1.text: A thunderous sneeze interrupts a solemn speech. The speaker attempts to continue while everyone snickers.

s2.text: (Sneezer) sneezes directly over a freshly prepared communal dish. The cook discards the affected portion and starts again, grumbling the entire time.

s3.text: A sneeze sends finely ground starch into the air, leaving two respected elders looking like pale statues.

s4.text: A speaker's dramatic revelation is drowned out. Nobody agrees what was said.

s5.text: A startled villager drops a basket; a nearby animal bolts; a clay pot tips over. The entire sequence takes seconds and becomes a favorite village story.

s6.text: Superstitious witnesses insist the sneeze was a warning. A calm researcher offers an ordinary explanation.

s7.text: The sneeze makes a healer look twice at a mislabeled basket, preventing a minor mistake.
